title: Restricted Fourier weight estimate
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $a,b$ be positive natural numbers with $2a\le b$. Given a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, a subset $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and $S\subseteq J$, define the restricted Fourier weight estimate as the average over the outer sample range of the square of the restricted Fourier coefficient estimate evaluated at each sample's fixed assignment.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
caveat: The outer sample range, fixed-assignment sampler, and coefficient estimate are not defined in the supplied descriptions.
